blurb: Stash 15.3 is the May 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine, expanding both search and evaluation with razoring, futility pruning, killer move ordering, square-root LMR, pawn structure, piece mobility, and dedicated elementary endgame evaluators (KQK, KRK, KBBK, KBNK, KQKR, KQKM, KRBK). Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper; Hash capped for 32-bit memory. Native bench uses a fixed 1 ms thread-startup wait, so comparison uses positions.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards for sliding-piece attack generation.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Negamax PVS with iterative deepening and transposition-table cutoffs in main and quiescence search.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Null-move pruning with zugzwang verification search.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Shallow-depth quiescence verification pruning for positions well below alpha.

features.label: Futility Pruning
features.implementation: Static-evaluation pruning margins at shallow non-PV depths.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Depth-scaled square-root reductions on late moves with re-search on fail-high.

features.label: Killer Moves
features.implementation: Two killer slots per ply prioritized alongside TT move, MVV-LVA captures, and SEE.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Zobrist-indexed hash table probed in both main search and quiescence search.

features.label: Pawn Structure
features.implementation: Evaluates isolated, doubled, backward, and passed pawns.

features.label: Piece Mobility
features.implementation: Counts attackable mobility squares for minor and major pieces.

features.label: Endgame Evaluators
features.implementation: Dedicated draw recognizers and mop-up evaluators for KQK, KRK, KBBK, KBNK, KQKR, KQKM, and KRBK.

features.label: Tapered Eval
features.implementation: Packed middlegame/endgame score pairs interpolated smoothly by game phase.
